correctness.rationale: The displayed mathematical claims check out; the frozen proof and verification narrative have two specific errors noted below. The two-sided linear-filter solution of the irreducible chain is stationary with |Z|≤1; the exponentially damped initial term tends to zero in probability in any stationary solution, giving uniqueness. For n≥1 the generator equations give m_n=C_{n-1} and C_n=n A_{n-1}/(n+R), with A_j=(j+T)m_j/(j+R+T) also at j=0. These give the displayed compact-support moment recurrence and the Beta(T/2,R/2) times Beta(1/2,R/2) square law. The two U densities have ratio proportional to u^{(T_2-T_1)/2}(1-u)^{(R_2-R_1)/2}, strictly decreasing throughout (0,1); the V densities are weakly ordered in the same direction. Conditioning the product tail on v>x² yields strict comparison for all interior x since the V densities are positive. The quantile and strictly increasing cost claims follow. For the density write a=T/2, c=R/2, t=x², D=B(a,c)B(1/2,c). For 0<|x|<1 the product integral is D^{-1} I_{a-1/2}(t), where I_p(t)=∫_t^1 u^{p-1}(1-u)^{c-1}(1-t/u)^{c-1}du. For p>0 split at 2t; the lower interval is O(t^p), and dominated convergence on the rest gives B(p,c). The substitution u=t/y gives I_p=t^p I_{-p}; for p=0 the middle interval [2t,1/2] gives log(1/t)+O(1) and both ends are O(1). At t→1 the substitution u=t+(1-t)s factors out (1-t)^{2c-1}, with remaining integral tending to B(c,c). These yield exactly the displayed constants and transitions, and c=1 reduces the same integral to an elementary power or logarithm. In the frozen proof line 71 the intermediate formula expressed as E|Y|^{-T}/B(T/2,c) omits a factor of two, though the displayed central coefficient is correct. The frozen script's 24 rate entries give 576 iterations but only 21 distinct rates and 441 distinct ordered pairs; the reported 37,096 assertion count is consistent with repetitions, not the distinct-pair claim. The frozen script was inspected, not executed.

The simultaneous partial order and rate-budget consequence follow by chaining the coordinate comparisons. The density coefficients and elementary line follow directly from the already known density by standard endpoint formulas.
